description: The only host-executed path in InkBlade. Bootstrap actions drop the static Rust probe into a target Pod on first foothold; they never upload or execute Python, and every other module is a declarative template executed by the probe.

artifacts.name: inkblade-probe
artifacts.notes: Static (musl recommended) Rust binary; sha256 is pinned by the release gate when present.

modules.purpose: First foothold only: upload + chmod the Rust probe binary. No module logic runs on the host.

forbidden: adapter/host fallback when a probe is missing
